capture_policy: Execution used uncommitted task tools at the stated base commit. Source hashes and this lineage were finalized after execution; no claim that every startup hash was captured live.
common.py: An unused antenna-offset helper was appended after initial media/calibration/primary-observation jobs started. Existing called functions were unchanged. The earlier module is reconstructed by removing that known appended helper; reconstruction is explicitly labelled.
manual_timing.py: T12 used v1 (exact snapshot saved before extension). T14/T15 used the cropped-flow extension. All manual tracks are timing-only and include failures.
calibrate.py: The first run had an in-place refinement-shift logging error. calibration_002 recomputed into a fresh directory after correction; only this corrected run is delivered.
event_sync.py: Preliminary mappings were superseded after adding visibility/stationary guards and single-event stage ambiguity handling. Only time_candidates_final_002 is delivered.
background_geometry.py: Synthetic camera-direction testing rejected an IPPE pathological solution before real spatial candidates ran. Delivered candidates use ITERATIVE with positive-depth/above-floor checks.
diagnose_markers.py: A later asset filter only avoids repeating completed clips; detection mathematics unchanged.
floor_annotation: Two automatic Hough attempts failed. Delivered P intersections are explicit human original-pixel annotations, with unknown annotation uncertainty.
assembly: final_contract_001 stopped at the Git owner check after writing copies. final_contract_003 is the selected complete assembly. Older directories are preserved and not published.
